context.text: A workflow redesign has two stable definitions: legacy50 and research-free36. New36 records explicitly bind the profile and run generation; legacy records keep original meanings. Flat generated SPEC-NNN.md hints may contain legacy stage meanings or previous-run guidance after a reset. SPEC is advisory and cannot authorize completion. Existing SPEC bytes must be preserved. Actual workflow progress must be one of the two known definitions; old unit fixtures sometimes use count3.

questions.instructions: Choose the safer scoped way to prevent mismatched flat generated SPEC hints from guiding a new36 run while preserving existing content and legacy behavior.

criteria.bind_and_preserve: For new36, bind generated SPEC to profile and generation; preserve mismatched existing bytes in guarded immutable digest-named history before replacing active alias. Archive failure leaves original unchanged. Preserve legacy generator behavior.
criteria.ignore_mismatch: Keep all flat SPEC files unchanged and rely on model instructions to ignore wrong-profile or previous-run hints.

questions.instructions: Choose production handling for inconsistent count3 progress in workflow pause/resume/reset helpers under the approved two-definition compatibility contract.

criteria.strict_known: Reject inconsistent actual progress; adapt miniature unit fixtures to real legacy50. Permit legacy evidence defaults only when actual workflow metadata is absent.
criteria.generic_counts: Retain arbitrary1..999 production counts solely to keep miniature unit fixtures unchanged.
